propositions: When a plan is re-reviewed after a BLOCK verdict with recorded blocking findings, a deterministic pre-check must compare cited evidence anchors from the blocking review against the current plan material to detect unchanged plan text.

If the plan's description component fingerprint is unchanged and at least one cited anchor remains verbatim, a warning must be printed naming the persisting findings and criteria, but the review must execute anyway (warn-only, no hard-block).
Findings with no verbatim-matchable anchors must never trigger the warning in isolation; the warning fires only when at least one anchor matches and all matched anchors are untouched.
The cited-anchor warning flag must be recorded as precheck.cited_anchor_warning (true or false on every review) in the sidecar metrics to enable offline measurement of hit rate and predictive value.
Re-reviews with plan changes that modify cited text must not trigger the warning, and verdict-reuse short-circuit logic must remain unaffected.
The pre-check must run with no LLM call, no new verdict flag, no decline, and no exit-code change, preserving the warn-only posture and escape-hatch behavior for verdict flips.
